notes.title: Free DLC "The Witcher Awakening" is available now
notes.content:
[h1]"The Witcher Awakening": New content and Improvements[/h1]

[h2]New weapon type: Ornaments[/h2]

New weapons have been added to the already wide and varied arsenal of the King of Darkness. Between swords, scythes, and pistols, now we can choose ornaments, magical artifacts with a destructive capacity that will delight his dar majesty (and also his followers).

Now players will be able to unlock this new type of weapon in the Famished Town forge and enjoy its 10 variants. Each of these ornaments features a unique design and attack patterns, in addition to the possibility of being ascended to the Summum level to unleash their full destructive potential.

The ascension diagrams can be obtained by performing certain feats with ornaments or completing specific missions... Everything will depend on the particular weapon.

With the inclusion of ornaments, a new weapon progression tree has also been added to the Starving City forge. Improve the attributes of this new type of weapon in each of the 8 branches and achieve the best performance in combat. A new gene called "Witchcraft" has also been added that increases the damage the King of Darkness does when wearing ornaments.

[h2]List of new weapons[/h2]

[b]- Basic Ornament[/b]
An ornament for rookies, no enchantments or special attributes

[b]- Frost Hydra[/b]
Launches icy spikes that deal cold damage
Invokes an orb that launches ice spikes at enemies in its way
[u]Summum:[/u] A layer of ice surrounds you, making you immune for a time while shooting spikes at nearby enemies.

[b]- Jibaro[/b]
Fires a voodoo projectile
Invokes zombies to fight at your side
[u]Summum:[/u] Angers your host by increasing their abilities

[b]- Dragon Claw[/b]
All attacks from this ornament deal fire damage
Invokes a fireball that explodes upon impact, causing area damage.
[u]Summum:[/u] Invokes a dragon that devastates the battlefield with a flare

[b]- Retro Controller[/b]
invokes a ship that will follow you and attack automatically
When killing enemies, there is a chance of power-ups spawning
You can modify its position or make it follow you.
[u]Summum:[/u] Bombs the screen with giant retroprojectiles

[b]- Basaltic Golem[/b]
Invokes a stone fist that hits at close range
Invokes two giant fists that stun all enemies in their impact area.
[u]Summum:[/u] Grants a shield

[b]- Áuryn[/b]
Invokes a retractable spear of roots that strikes enemies in its area.
Invokes poisonous spores into the world that are destroyed when hit with the roots.
Invokes a flurry of roots that hit all enemies in its area
[u]Summum:[/u] Invokes a Sprout of Eternity

[b]- Typhoon[/b]
Invokes Typhon who will follow you and attack automatically
Creates a wind explosion around Typhoon that deals area damage.
You can modify its position with the primary attack
[u]Summum:[/u] Generates a tornado around Typhon that attracts enemies towards its center

[b]- Elven Lyre[/b]
Throws a musical note and every certain number of notes throw a powered one
Releases a chord that enthralls the enemy for a time
[u]Summum:[/u] Throw chords in all directions

[b]- Holy Scriptures[/b]
All attacks from this ornament deal holy damage
Invokes a spiraling hammer
Invokes a celestial mallet that bounces off surfaces, striking enemies in its path
[u]Summum:[/u] Launches a purifying ray that hits enemies in its area. The beam can be directed in any direction

[h2]Seed history[/h2]

The friendly botanist of Famished Town has created a seed history allowing players to check information about all the adventures they have already enjoyed, including genetic data and several statistics.

This addition is located in Yado's hut, just to the right of the seed germinator.

[h2]New status ailments[/h2]

2 new status ailments have been added:

- Cold: Adds cold charges to the enemy and freezes them when it reaches 100
- Charm: Enemies affected by this status will fight on your side

[h2]New skins[/h2]

5 new skins have been included for the King of Darkness:

- Spider Sense
- Lich King
- Déjà vu
- Starborn
- Tropic Thunder

[h2]New achievements[/h2]

5 new achievements have been added related to the inclusion of ornaments:

- Wizard: Unlock the ornament
- Gun Nut: Fully upgrade (damage node not included) 4 weapon types
- Do It Yourself: Forge 16 new weapons
- Expert Weapon Tester: Unlock 36 relic weapons with Dummytama
- Expert Summum: Unlock 36 ascended weapons with Dummytama

[h2]Bugs fixed[/h2]
- Fixed some typos
- Fixed a bug where the end run screen would sometimes crash
- Fixed an issue where the Argentum Pistol Ascension Chart could not be obtained when completing the requirement: defeat Count Xander with that weapon
- Fixed a bug where the ascension diagram for the Touch of Death scythe could not be obtained when fulfilling the requirement: spin the Death Roulette while that weapon is equipped

notes.title: Summum Aeterna Final Release
notes.content:
[h1]New content and improvements included in v1.0 of Summum Aeterna[/h1]

[h2]Seeds and genes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Many of the existing genes have been redesigned to adjust to the new difficulty progression system
[*] The algorithm for assigning genes to seeds has been modified to adjust to the new difficulty scaling system
[*] The difficulty scaling algorithm based on seed level has been modified to adjust it
[*] New type of Seed: "Random Seed"
[list]The worlds created by germinating these seeds are affected by the "Cause" Gene, which will greatly increase the luck of the King according to its rarity, and by the "Effect" Gene, which will increase the level progression of enemies, making them even more lethal. In addition, all aspects of the seed (Genes, enemies, and worlds) will be completely random and will be modified at their own will during the game.[/list][*] New genes listed below have been included
[/list]
[h3]New genes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Gemological: Upgrade a gem every x levels of Chaos
[*] Sharp: More % damage with swords
[*] Lethal Slash: More % damage with scythes
[*] Piercing: More % damage with guns
[*] Truce: More % healing when defeating bosses
[*] Weakening: Enemies weaken
[*] Strengthening: Enemies are immune to weakness
[*] Antifreeze: Enemies are immune to freezing
[*] Coagulant: Enemies are immune to bleeding out
[*] Fireproof Enemies are immune to fire
[*] Antidote: Enemies are immune to poison
[/list]
[h2]New world:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added the final definitive world for Summum Aeterna: "Cosmic Vessel"
[*] The King of Darkness must delve into the depths of an environment that gives off a mysterious yet familiar aura, where the walls pulsate and evil in its purest form awaits the arrival of a champion.
[/list]
[h3]New enemies:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Arterial Basophil
[*] Retroviruses
[*] Infection Globule
[*] Arthropoid
[*] Intravenous Sentinel
[*] Symbiotic Ganglion
[*] Primary Tumor
[/list]
[h3]New boss:[/h3]
[list]
[*] A new boss has been added, it is the definitive final enemy, the one who will conclude the adventure contained in a seed.
[*] His identity is a mystery, but his power is unimaginable. The King of Darkness will not be able to escape from his clutches, because the beast has awakened, and is thirsty for revenge.
[/list]
[h2]Equipment:[/h2]
[list]
[*] A new "Equipment" system has been included
[list]During your adventures you will now find different pieces of armor equipped with statistical improvements, in addition, each piece belongs to a collection and by equipping multiple pieces from the same collection you will unlock new and incredible powers.[/list]
[/list][h2]New NPC:[/h2]
[list]
[*] New NPC Available "Alfred, at the service of his majesty"
[list] The best tailor in Aeterna always ready to put at the disposal of the King of Darkness his knowledge of elegance, fashion and, above all, effectiveness in combat. [/list]
[/list][h2]Altered states:[/h2]
[list]
[*] The operation of altered states has been redesigned so that their damage is more relevant
[*] 2 new altered states have been added:
[list]Corruption
Sacred[/list]
[/list][h2]Gems:[/h2]
[list]
[*] The operation of some gems has been adjusted and redesigned to adapt them to the new progression system
[*] 3 new gems have been added:
[list]- Inferno: Adds fire damage charges
- Bloody: Adds charges of bleeding damage
- Toxic: Adds charges of poison damage[/list]
[/list][h2]New weapons:[/h2]
[list]
[*] The operation of some weapons has been adjusted and redesigned to adapt them to the new progression system
[*] 3 new weapons have been added:
[list]- Inquisitor: A sword forged to punish heretics and convert pagans, wielded by the leader of a now-extinct religious order.
- Anathema: A scythe bathed in the blood of a martyr and blessed by the Worshipers of Chaos. A cursed weapon, for less civilized times.
- Argentum: This devastating weapon belonged to the most famous vampire hunter, until the lords of the night gouged out his eyes and emptied his veins.[/list]
[/list][h2]Game progress:[/h2]
[list]
[*] The difficulty system has been redesigned by further adjusting the scaling and difficulty curve, thanks to these new adjustments now all the game content will be accessible to any type of player, from the most casual to the most hardcore, maintaining still its essence and always posing a challenge for each of them.
[*] A new currency "Crimson Core" has been included which is used to upgrade equipment.
[*] The final reward system has been redesigned to more fairly reward players based on their progress through the worlds.
[*] New improvements have been added to the Fountain of the Two Crowns:
[list]Probability by Supercritical
Longevity II[/list][*] Added new improvements to the Ancient Tree:
[list]- Vial Plus
- Seed Plus
- Plus Equipment[/list][*] Changed how the Wheel of Death works. Now they do not give the blessing and the special gift at the same time. First you must fulfill the condition to remove the curse and thus receive the blessing of Your Deathness.
[*] Adjusted the spawning of some curses (such as "die with one hit") to fit higher rarities.
[*] 3 new special gifts have been added:
[list]- Obtain a Guardian Angel (or several)
- Increase your supercritical chance
- Increase your maximum life[/list]
[/list][h2]Feats:[/h2]
[list]
[*] The feat system has been added, through it you can keep track of the milestones achieved by the King of Darkness and fight to achieve the most difficult ones. There are more than 150, so you have a lot of work to do...
[/list]
[h2]Gameplay:[/h2]
[list]
[*] The in-game UI has been redesigned to improve visibility and to make it cooler.
[*] An "overlay" map has been included as a new in-game functionality
[*] The run summary menu has been redesigned, dividing it into 2 sections:
[list]- Combat Token: current weapon, current equipment and summary of statistics
- Seed Token: ongoing events (curses, wishes), seed progress, seed information (genes, level)[/list][*] Big game-wide performance improvements have been implemented.
[*] The performance options system has been improved so that each of them better adjust the settings.
[/list]
[h2]Available languages:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Spanish
[*] English
[*] French
[*] German
[*] Italian
[*] Russian
[*] Simplified Chinese)
[*] Traditional Chinese)
[*] Korean
[*] Japanese
[*] Portuguese (Brazil)
[/list]
The most important changes, improvements and additions are listed here. Dozens of modifications have been made, so many that detailing them would take a lot, and we don't want to waste your time...

Enjoy the adventures of the King of Darkness! Thanks a lot for your support :)

notes.title: Steam Deck Performance
notes.content:
The final release date for Summum Aeterna is getting closer! September 14 is almost here, and besides new playable content, the game will also include performance improvements, bug fixes, and a completely compatible version for the Steam portable console.

Our previous title Aeterna Noctis got the Steam Deck verification just two months after its launch day, so it is a matter of time before Steam finally reviews Summum Aeterna and grats us with the official verification. 

For those who enjoy playing on Steam Deck, keep in mind that the game is playable in its current state:
[list]
[*] In-game interface texts are legible on the console, allowing users to navigate through menus and skill trees just like on a monitor screen. You won't miss a detail about the game mechanics!
[*] Summum Aeterna runs smoothly on the Steam Deck, the game adapts its graphics to the portable console. The artistic value and the beauty of the environments and characters do not affect the game experience.
[*] The gameplay itself is perfectly suited to the features of the portable console. The game integrates all functionality available on the controller configuration.
[/list]Very soon Summum Aeterna will receive official verification by Steam to clear up any doubts regarding its compatibility with Steam Deck. Meanwhile, those of you who own the portable console will be able to play our Roguelite without issues and enjoy its incredible performance.

See you all on September 14!

notes.title: Released date confirmed and new Major Update: "Legacy of the Arcana"
notes.content:
[h1]Released date confirmed[/h1]

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42192295/6fd940f1499b4522a634a2ce454f762c02439eb2.png[/img]

Summum Aeterna, the prequel to Aeterna Noctis, will hit all platforms simultaneously next September with its final version v1.0. The frenetic Roguelite starring his dark majesty is getting closer to ending its period in Early Access. We aim for September for the launch window, including a simultaneous release on PC and Nintendo, PlayStation and Xbox consoles.

The final release is coming up!

[h1]New content and improvements included in the "Legacy of the Arcane"[/h1]


[previewyoutube=u6cKrGnuRd0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Seeds:[/h2]
[list]
[*] New type of influence: "Legacy of the Arcane"
[list]Those seeds influenced by the arcana will allow the player to get arcane cards in the germinated worlds
The King of Darkness will find the arcane cards in the influenced worlds eliminating the dream hunters, but it will be the cards that decide for themselves when to activate[/list][*] Arcane Cards
[list] Each arcane card will have its own consequences and will alter the world
The initial deck will have 3 cards, the rest are unlocked by progressing in the worlds influenced by the arcana[/list][*] Effects of the cards: "Alterations of Fate"
[list]Added several alterations with positive, negative and ambiguous effects. These effects will kick in once the found cards activate
[/list][*] Not all card effects are the same. There are those known as "Radiant Cards", which will have much greater consequences when they wake up, but their spawn rate is very small
[*] Added a new influence table "Legacy of the Arcane" in the Wandering God dimension

[/list][h2]Arcane Deck:[/h2]
[list]
[*] 12 cards have been added to your deck:
[list]Death
Devil
Priestess
World
Judgment
Hermit
Emperor
Wizard
Tower
Justice
Force
Fool
[/list][*] Each card has a brief description of its nature, and also expands the lore of the Aeterna Universe

[/list][h2]Genetics:[/h2]
[list]
[*] "Royal Forge" gene has been removed from uninfluenced worlds
[*] The genetics system in Yado's lab has been redesigned. Now there are 3 machines that differ according to their options:
[list]- Germinator: germinate the seeds creating worlds
- Seed furnace: allows the fusion of seeds and their recycling transforming the destroyed seed into runes
- Genetic alterer: allows you to modify the genetic code of a seed[/list][*] New genetic functionalities have been added:
[list]
Gene alterer now includes a host of new gene modification effects
A specific vial is required for each mod, these vials can be found in worlds or obtained through rewards[/list][*] Added new gene types:
[list]
- Dominant: prevails in the seed even if it is mutated, it is unlocked in difficulty 2
- Coding: hides its name and description making it impossible to know its effect, it is unlocked in difficulty 4[/list][*] The "Will of the Kings" mode has become a seed influence. There are now 3 seed influences:
[list]Will of the Kings
Dominion of Chaos
Legacy of the Arcana[/list][*] Seeds can contain a maximum of 3 influences and they are all compatible with each other
[*] The King of Darkness can get influenced seeds in two ways:
[list]
- Imbuing a seed with an influence via the genetic alterer
- Obtain already influenced seeds as a reward or through the seed seller Rasen Lupine[/list]
[/list][h2]Gameplay:[/h2]
[list]
[*] New challenge system available: "Board of Champions"
[list]Through this system, the highest level seed completed in the shortest possible time by each competitor will be registered[/list][*] The reward for being in the top 3 places will be a gold, silver or bronze crown, which the king will wear in-game regardless of the player's skin, and as long as he stays on the podium
[*] There are two world ranking systems:
[list]Influenced seeds ranking
Uninfluenced seeds ranking[/list]
[/list][h2]Rooms:[/h2]
[list]
[*] New room available "Chamber of the Arcane"
[list] A temporary location where the tarot reader Morgana awaits the arrival of the monarch of this cycle[/list]
[/list][h2]NPCs:[/h2]
[list]
[*] New NPC Available "Morgana, Dealer of Destiny"
[list]Your first encounter with this lady of divination will be during your adventures in the sprout worlds, but after that you can visit her whenever you want in her shop in Starving City to unlock and understand how the arcane cards work. Do not be fooled by her behavior, after all, Morgana is only an intermediary, since it is the arcana that speak of her through her voice[/list][*] Morgana will give the King of Darkness some arcane-influenced seeds after first speaking to her, so her dark majesty can experience first-hand how the cards work

[/list][h2]Miscellany:[/h2]
[list]
[*] The name of the "Vial of the Kings" has been changed, now it is called "Chalice of the Kings"
[*] The system of progression and unlocking of new elements in the game has been modified to better adjust the difficulty curve
[*] Fixed a bug where sometimes you couldn't properly continue the talking head quest and get its reward
[*] Changed the price and spawn rate of items in Chaos shops
[*] Fixed a bug where the Chaos compass icon was not displaying correctly on the HUD
[*] Fixed a bug where it would not correctly load the world level on seeds influenced by the Dominion of Chaos
[*] Fixed a bug where the King of Darkness would not start his dialogue the first time he visited Hyperborea
[*] Fixed a bug where items in shops would sometimes not match when loading a game
[*] Fixed a bug where key rooms in the Opera House were sometimes not distributed correctly
[*] Fixed a bug where the Valkyries' hammer would sometimes come off the stage
[*] Fixed a bug where defeating Count Xander would sometimes keep his bat particles[/list]

[h1]The new Aeterna Noctis DLC will arrive on May 22[/h1]

They will also contain "Chaos Chests" which will grant a large amount of Chaos energy when opened[/list][*] New type of Seed: "Forgotten Star"
[list]By germinating this unique seed, the King of Darkness will be able to visit the forgotten star, home of the "Hand of Chaos", a mysterious place that contains countless rewards to discover[/list]

[list]
Dark Matter Worm
Dark Matter Caterpillar
Dark Executor
Void Sphere
Chaos Punisher
[/list]

[list]

[list]Increases Chaos obtained based on monolith level, but will infuse an additional Gene into the current seed[/list]

[list]

[list]Mystery Seeds will only indicate their starting world, rarity, and influence affecting them, but will not display their genes until they are acquired. It's like opening a box of surprises![/list][*] New artifact available: "Ascension Flower"
[list]Ascends your current weapon to Summum level[/list]
[/list][h2]NPCs:[/h2]
[list]
[*] New NPC Available "Zero, the Wandering God"
[list]A rift to an unknown dimension has opened in the middle of Famished City... Inside, a mysterious being that mortals call "Wandering God" seems to have the strange power to modify the influences in the seeds, being able to alter its effects on germinated worlds[/list]
[/list][h2]Status ailments:[/h2]
[list]
[*] New ailment state available: "Void"
[list]While the King of Darkness suffers "Void" his Chaos energy will progressively reduce over time[/list]
[/list][h2]Gems:[/h2]
[list]
[*] New status ailment gem available: Void

[list]The double gems contain the power of two gems, whatever they are, fused into one. They are extremely difficult to find and their rarity level is Relic, but whoever wears them will feel the true power in their hands[/list]

[list]
[*] Updated "Parasite" sword (Ascension available)
[list]
· Its behavior has been modified so that it has a defensive and an offensive effect depending on the percentage of the King's life:
· Grants a heal on hit equal to 0.005% base + 0.002% of max health per rarity level for every 1% health below 50%
· Increases damage by base 1% + 0.1% per rarity level for every 1% health above 50%
SUMMUM:[/list][list] -Recharge: With the damage dealt[/list][list] -Passive: Grants Defense worth 0.4 base + 0.1 per rarity level for every 1% health below 50%[/list][list] -Passive: Grants Base 0.5% Dodge Chance + 0.1% per rarity level for every 1% below 50%[/list][list] -Passive: Increases critical damage by 0.5% base value + 0.1% per rarity level for every 1% health above 50%[/list][list] -Passive: Increases critical chance by 0.1% base + 0.1% per rarity level for every 1% health above 50%[/list][list] -Active: Doubles the values of the stats granted for base 2s + 0.5s per rarity level[/list]
[*] Updated "Poison" sword (Ascension available)
[list]
· Its behavior has been modified so that it benefits from each status ailment caused on the enemy
· Now increases Critical Chance by 2% base + 1% per rarity level for each status ailment inflicted on the enemy hit
SUMMUM:[/list][list] -Recharge: On damage with any status ailment[/list][list] -Passive: Increases damage dealt with status ailments by a base 50% + 25% per rarity level[/list][list] -Active: When damaging enemies with status ailment you will heal for 0.1% base + 0.1% per rarity level of your maximum health for 3s base + 0.5s per rarity level[/list]
[*] Updated "Healer Reaper" scythe (Ascension available)
[list]
SUMMUM:[/list][list] -Recharge: Automatic 5s base - 0.5s per rarity level[/list][list] -Passive: Healing Grim Reaper transforms into Hungry Grim Reaper. Loses all healing effects and now deals 1% of your health damage on each attack. Increases damage 100% + 25% per rarity level[/list][list] -Active: Change weapon mode[/list]
[*] Updated "Plague" scythe (Ascension available)
[list]
· Now applies the "Debilitating" status to enemies hit, reducing the damage they deal by a base 20% + 5% per rarity level
SUMMUM:[/list][list] -Recharge: With the damage of the curse[/list][list] -Passive: Now "Caleb" will accompany you, restoring you a base 0.1% + 0.05% per rarity level of your maximum health each time the curse deals damage[/list][list] -Active: "Caleb" launches a massive attack that applies 5 curse charges to all enemies in its area[/list]
[*] Updated "Laser Rifle" pistol (Ascension available)
[list]
SUMMUM:[/list][list] -Recharge: With the damage dealt[/list][list] -Active: Trigger a massive attack that deals 100% of your secondary damage throughout the King's area of vision[/list]
[*] Updated "Devastating" pistol (Ascension available)
[list]
SUMMUM:[/list][list] -Recharge: With the damage dealt[/list][list] -Passive: Nullifies the primary attack, the secondary ammunition is infinite and the shots track the enemies[/list][list] -Active: Fire a "KOAP" that deals 500% of your secondary damage in a massive area on impact[/list]

[*] The automatic aiming system for pistols has been improved
[/list]

[/list]

[*] Rooms affected by influences in worlds have a special mark on the minimap
[*] Added name to gems in selections and shops without hovering over them
[/list]

[list]

[/list]

notes.content:
[h1]Summary of the Aeternum Game Studios showcase[/h1]

[previewyoutube=3Van4s7jnhA;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]DLC for Aeterna Noctis[/h2]

"Pit of the Damned" is the first playable DLC for Aeterna Noctis, and it will take us to explore a new area full of new challenges, new enemies, and, of course, a new and fearsome final boss. The images show the King of Darkness making his way through some catacombs featuring our classic puzzle and level design. Apparently, an ancient evil claims the monarch's presence in that crypt... The visuals speak for themselves, and the DLC feels more Aeterna Noctis than ever! Its launch is scheduled for early 2023.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39578084/dd49675441f76702d57eca2f7aba303f36ce3848.jpg[/img]

[h2]Summum Aeterna Launch[/h2]

Summum Aeterna will end its Early Access period at the end of 2023, with a simultaneous release on PC and PlayStation, Xbox and Nintendo consoles. Our Roguelite title will continue to receive new updates such as new worlds, more weapons, and even more challenges over the next few months until its final release at the end of 2023. Check out the roadmap for the next year:

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39578084/d428eea74073ca9d61ce44b4032820b283aba25e.jpg[/img]

[h2]Aeterna Lucis[/h2]

Our fandom had been theorizing for a while about a possible sequel to their favorite Metroidvania. The jewel in the crown during the showcase was a brief, but long-awaited announcement… The confirmation that Aeterna Lucis, the sequel to Aeterna Noctis, is currently under development. We haven't revealed more details for now except 2024 as the launch window. Are you excited?

In conclusion, 2023 is full of surprises for lovers of the Aeterna Universe. A DLC for Aeterna Noctis at the beginning of the year, the multiplatform and simultaneous release of Summum Aeterna at the end of 2023, and the highly anticipated sequel Aeterna Lucis for 2024.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39578084/498bc484e3a90ffc14fcf8d76ba9316a26567a6b.jpg[/img]

Remember that all this is possible thanks to your support!

[/list]

[list]
[*] New item type available: Crafting Blueprints

New blueprints available: "Weapons": Through these plans, it will be possible to unlock new weapons allowing them to appear in the shops and elections of the worlds
New blueprints available: "Summums": Through these plans, it will be possible to ascend the weapons to the Summum level, unleashing all their power and endowing the king with powerful unique abilities.[/list]

notes.title: New major update: "Blood Moon"
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42192295/364ef67ffdf8524eaf395efdbe26c84e2058a7ca.jpg[/img]

Our Roguelite does not stop growing and has just received its second major update entitled "Blood Moon", a patch already downloadable on Steam and that adds dozens of hours of new content to the adventures of the King of Darkness in Summum Aeterna.

The gaming community can now enjoy “Blood Moon”, a second major update that introduces a new world and a new final boss as well as a new NPC, various weapon and enemy performance improvements, and more options. combat and world customization. We are in for the biggest update Summum Aeterna has received to date:

[previewyoutube=D9r_n98iSN4;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1]New content and improvements included in the "Blood Moon" Update[/h1]

[h2]Worlds:[/h2]
[list]
[*]New world available: "Dark Castle"
[list]Area 1: Cursed City
Area 2: Dark Castle[/list]
[/list][h2]Gameplay:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Changed the effect of status ailments on the King:
[list]The "Poisoned" status will now deal a low amount of damage over time and slow movement by 50% for the duration of its effect[/list][list]The "Bleed Out" status will now deal a medium amount of damage over time and reduce healing by 50% for the duration of its effect[/list][list]The "Burn" status will now deal a high amount of damage in a reduced amount of time[/list][*]The "Stomp" attack will now kill enemies with max health below a threshold in one hit
[*]The animation cancel window on pistol attacks has been extended to improve the King's reaction to attacks
[/list]
[h2]Enemies:[/h2]
[list]
[*]New enemies available:
[list]Skeleton Archer
Skeleton Giant
Lich
Rabid Bat
Rear Soldier
Steel Fighter
Steel Mutilator
Dark Wizard
Assassin Bandit[/list][*]The impact calculation against the platforms of the projectile of the enemy "Ax throwing warrior" has been improved
[*]Fixed a bug where enemies would sometimes not die when the "True Cure" gem was equipped
[*]Fixed a bug where the "Electric Slug" enemy would not unfreeze when it exploded
[/list]
[h2]Bosses:[/h2]
[list]
[*]New boss available: Count Xander
[list]The death of several soldiers under the orders of the King of Darkness makes the cursed monarch go to the Dark Castle to meet with a former lackey and thus discover the mystery behind these crimes.[/list][*]Improved the rarity of items received as rewards from final bosses[*]Fixed a bug where the figure puzzle in the battle against "Dantilus" would sometimes appear green even though the pieces did not match
[/list]

[list]

[*] Fixed a bug where the alchemist miniboss grenades would sometimes not explode properly against the ground
[*] Fixed a bug where "Ledasios" would sometimes exit the battle room when performing his charge attack
[*] Fixed a bug where "Ledasios" would sometimes get paralyzed while performing his spear-throwing attacks

[list]
[*] Changed the minimum and maximum distance that the projectile of the "Taser" gun reaches
[*] Scythe "Execute" ability cast time reduced from 1 to 0.75 seconds
[*] Reduced the opacity of the shot effects of the "Clipped" pistol to improve its visibility
[*] Fixed a bug where multiple status ailments were applied in one hit when the "Status Wheel" gem was equipped on the "Quadra Cannon" weapon
[*] Fixed a bug where the King could sometimes fire pistols while frozen
[*] Reduced the life time of the projectiles of the pistols when leaving the King's vision range
[/list]
[h2]Gems:[/h2]
[list]
[*] New Gem Type: Unique Rarity 
[list] Unique rarity gems cannot be upgraded [/list][*] Instant kill percentage of "Coup de Grace" gem is reduced from 3% base + 2% per rarity to 3% base + 1% per rarity
[*] Increased the percentage of health recovered from the "Accurate Heal" gem from 0.5% to 1% per rarity level
[*] Changed the seed creation algorithm to group their genes and adjust them to the difficulty curve

[list]
[*] New World Seed: Dark Castle

[/list][h2]NPCs:[/h2]

[*] New NPC "Usnar Ali"
[list]Our friend Usnar the "Banker" will allow you to exchange currencies with a fair deal most of the time, plus, every time you come back from your adventures he will have great offers that you won't be able to miss. Keep in mind that the Bank's opening hours are always during the day[/list][*] Changed mechanics of "Rasen Lupine":

notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42192295/d272c074f6f438bee988221f73d4a1556b55aa0e.jpg[/img]

Summum Aeterna releases its first major update called "Mother of Demons", now available on Steam and packed with new content for the Roguelite from the creators of Aeterna Noctis.

Following in the footsteps of our roadmap, we've just released the first of many updates to extend the content for our latest project. "Mother of Demons" is the name of this first major update which adds many hours of fun to the adventures of the King of Darkness in Roguelite format. Here you can see the teaser:

https://youtu.be/aq4JAHhbHqo
[h1]New content and improvements included in "Demons' Mother" Update[/h1]

[h2]Gameplay:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Changed the radius and improved the visual effect of the "Unleashed Plague" upgrade on the scythe
[*] Added a visual effect on enemies and the King when affected by status ailments
[*] The "Frozen" ailment can now also affect the King
[list]Suffering from this state will prevent the King from moving and he will be vulnerable to attacks. He will be able to regain mobility by repeatedly pressing the attack button, receiving an enemy hit or passing the certain freezing time[/list][*] Dash's "Cooldown Time" has been reduced to improve its response on the ground
[/list]
[h2]Rooms and events:[/h2]
[list]
[*] New challenge room: "Shrine of Idalith"
[list]The rooms in honor of the one known as "Mother of Demons" contain a special treasure called "Offering to Idalith", to obtain it you must defeat a random member of the "Grim Horde".[/list][*] 3 minibosses: The minions of Idalith protect the treasures of their infernal lady (currently 3 minibosses available)[list]"Valatuk, Lord of War" 
"Samnidas, Plaguebearer" 
"Ledasios, Grand Inquisitor"
[/list][/list]
[h2]Seeds:[/h2]
[list]
[*] New seed type: "World Seed"
[list]They will create a new adventure setting the initial world with the one associated with this seed [/list][*] New World Seed: "Eclipse Citadel"
[*] New World Seed: "Harunokaze Village"
[*] Current seeds have been transformed into "World Seeds" of type "Eclipse Citadel"
[*] The maximum number of seeds the King can carry has been increased from 40 to 999
[*] It is now possible to sort seeds by level, rarity and drop
[*] Added a "skulls" marker in the seed info to indicate their difficulty
[/list]
[h2]Worlds:[/h2]
[list]

notes.title: Summum Aeterna: Early Access Roadmap 2022
notes.content:
Summum Aeterna is a Roguelite game that combines world crawler mechanics with fast-paced combat and a unique 2D art style. Taking the role of the King of Darkness, you'll explore uncharted territories populated with treasures, traps, hordes of enemies, and powerful bosses. 

[b]Day One content[/b]

Let's take a look at what is included in the first version of the game currently available on Steam:
[list]
[*] 2 worlds featuring 2 different areas each
[*] 2 final bosses
[*] 1 special room… The Death Roulette! Featuring a mechanic that makes your run even more interesting… Would you spin it? Be careful, it could curse your game or make you unstoppable!
[*] 3 weapon types: swords, scythes, and pistols
[*] 21 unique weapons, each one with different offensive and passive attributes
[*] Introduction to the Seed Mechanic, a unique world generator system: Each seed you find generates a unique world with different enemy behaviour, rewards, special rooms, and map size depending on its genes and rareness.
[*] More than 20 unique world modifiers: The so-called “seed genes” make each seed different from the last, and so will the world generated from them!
[*] Permanent character upgrade system: No matter how many times you’re defeated, your progression in the skill tree will be saved!
[*] Permanent world upgrade system: The world improvements you unlocked will last forever, even if you are defeated a hundred times!
[*] Weapon customization options: Add new attributes and improve the combat performance of your weapons by embedding gems
[*] More than 15 epic music themes
[/list]
Everything mentioned above is already included in the current playable version of Summum Aeterna. We rely on the community feedback to improve the gaming experience. We are willing to include new features based on our player base opinions as well. Feel free to send us your suggestions and share your thoughts!


[b]Project timeline[/b]

Summum Aeterna is scheduled to be in early access for a year and a half, so the full version will be ready at some point in 2024, but there’s no specific end date. However, all main updates for the next months are already scheduled, and the content for the first half of 2023 is almost planned.


[b]Future content scope[/b]

Now that the first version is available, let’s take a look at the future content. Right now we have 4 major upgrades to cover the game progression until the end of 2022. Small patches could also be released between each main update to solve possible bugs or expand the customization possibilities. 

This is the roadmap of our first cycle in Early Access:

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42192295/464a562e87ab6da299166ad5fdd878ac3cd75b4a.jpg[/img]


[b]Major Update 1 - July[/b]
[list]
[*] 1 new challenge room that will offer a true combat challenge only recommended for the most skilled players… The Shrines of Idalith!
[*] 3 minibosses
[*] 3 new weapons: Mantis Claw (scythe), Jade Katana (sword), and Taser Gun (pistol)
[*] 2 new NPCs: Rasen Lupine and the Dummy
[*] 1 new seed type: Chance of Worlds
[*] New lethal genes
[*] More gems
[*] Many more surprises!
[/list]
[b]Major Update 2 – August[/b]
[list]
[*] 1 new world (2 currently) including 2 different areas (4 currently)
[*] 1 new final boss (2 currently)
[*] More genes to modify and alter the worlds
[/list]
[b]Major Update 3 - September[/b]
[list]
[*] 1 new world (3 currently) including 2 different areas (6 currently)
[*] 1 new final boss (3 currently)
[*] 1 new weapon type (3 currently)
[*] 8 unique weapons, each one with different offensive and passive features (24 currently)
[/list]
[b]Major Update 4 – October / November[/b]
[list]
[*] 1 new seed type… Exotics Seeds! They will teleport you to a unique world including exclusive features. Would you survive? 
[*] 1 new type of world including a certain challenge to overcome
[*] Inclusion of legendary weapons, allowing access to more than 30 unique tools of destruction!
[/list]
[b]What will come after Major Upgrade 4?[/b]
[list]
[*] We will add more types of special rooms, and some of them will include new upgrade mechanics
[*] Expect more unique variants for each weapon type
[*] More worlds are also on our radar
[*] New gems will be added
[*] More available options in the skill and world tree
[*] All the good ideas provided by the community to make Summum Aeterna even more fun!
[/list]
We will update the roadmap and the next content scope in early 2023. Thank you so much for your constant support! We rely on you to make Summum Aeterna an epic experience.
